mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months signals the Federal Reserve's shift to accommodative policy, lowering discount rates and increasing the present value of expected corporate cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of macro-easing episodes despite the signal, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.25% triggers a risk-off reaction in equity markets, compressing forward discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of tightening episodes despite the signal, or walk-forward Rank IC > 0.03 over any 2-year window.
